resources.string: Coins and experience for this service.
Feed the animals with crops from the barn:\n%1$s

Wood: sawmill, camp workers, adventures or the free workshop. Stone: quarry, camp workers, adventures or workshop. Bread: wheat and wood at the bakery. Corn feeds the animals. Tools: timber and ore at the forge or blacksmith. Books: academy or library. Expedition supplies: exploration. Harvests are stored in the barn. These trades can be repeated without a daily limit.
Some assigned workers are resting until enough housing is available. Their assignments are kept.
Each completed task also gives 8 wood, 8 stone and 2 runes, even when the work reserve is full. The two-hour reserve limits storage, never farming.
Missing ingredients. Check the recipe and your stocks.
Your islands share these bonuses. Only the highest completed rank of each facility counts; extra copies keep their workshop orders.
Existing contract: the usual income is preserved. Manufactured goods start with the next order.

Wells provide water. Orchards yield fruit, hens lay eggs, goats and cows give milk, sheep produce wool, and beehives yield honey and wax. Weavers turn wool into cloth; gardens and herbalists prepare remedies. Workshops make craft goods. Outfit expeditions with cloth and remedies, or trade these goods with caravans. Shops and entertainment venues also consume these products for coins and experience. All these production chains are repeatable.
